title: Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno
description:
Código da vaga: 58034



Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Conhecimentos sólidos em Kubernetes, AWS, e .NET CORE , além de experiência em Arquitetura de Software, SOLID, Clean Code e práticas avançadas de Code Review .
  • CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios
  • 100% remoto.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Delivery Manager para liderar a execução de projetos de implantação de soluções AWS em clientes dos EUA. A posição exige experiência sólida em gestão de projetos de escopo fechado e híbrido, além de forte habilidade de comunicação em inglês (nível C1), para interação com stakeholders internacionais.


Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar projetos complexos de curta duração (em média 3 meses), incluindo assessments, POCs e MVPs.
  • Conduzir implantações de projetos AWS em clientes dos EUA.
  • Liderar equipes multidisciplinares, garantindo alinhamento, motivação e produtividade.
  • Acompanhar e controlar cronogramas, escopo, riscos e entregas.
  • Realizar acompanhamento e controle financeiro dos projetos, garantindo saúde orçamentária e rentabilidade.
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com stakeholders e clientes, assegurando qualidade e satisfação nas entregas.
  • Aplicar práticas de gestão de projetos (de preferência com certificação PMP).


Requisitos

  • Inglês fluente (nível C1) – imprescindível.
  • Experiência comprovada na gestão de projetos complexos, preferencialmente de tecnologia e cloud.
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação de soluções AWS é um diferencial relevante.
  • Experiência em gestão de equipes e coordenação de recursos.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de projetos híbridas (ágil e waterfall).
  • Certificação PMP (desejável).
  • Forte capacidade de organização, comunicação e resolução de problemas.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em consultorias de tecnologia.
  • Atuação prévia em projetos internacionais


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the AI/R Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: UGC Content Creator (Freelance)
description:
About the Company

We are a fast-growing global mobile app company building digital products used by millions of people worldwide. Our focus is on creating scalable, data-driven consumer applications that combine creativity, technology, and performance marketing.


Role Overview

Produce high-quality 30–60 second short-form videos for TikTok and Instagram, promoting consumer-focused mobile applications to global audiences.

Translate creative briefs into compelling, performance-oriented content while also bringing fresh, original ideas to the table.

Develop powerful hooks, relatable scenarios, and innovative use cases that capture attention within the first seconds.

Continuously research trends, viral formats, and competitor strategies to keep content relevant and competitive.

Collaborate closely with the Marketing team to align content with growth goals, campaign strategy, and performance metrics.

Share learnings and creative suggestions that help improve overall content strategy, engagement rates, and conversion performance.


Candidate Profile

Strong interest in TikTok, Instagram Reels, and short-form content ecosystems.

Ability to create engaging, high-retention videos that align with platform trends (portfolio or sample work is highly preferred).

Strong creative instinct with the ability to turn everyday concepts into attention-grabbing content.

Confidence on camera — or strong storytelling ability without appearing on camera.

Understanding of audience behavior, content psychology, and the importance of the first 3 seconds.

Self-driven and organized, capable of managing freelance deliverables independently.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, feedback-driven environment.

English proficiency is a plus, as content targets an international audience.


Compensation

Per-Video Payment Model: You’ll receive compensation for each completed and approved video, with ongoing project opportunities based on performance

title: Finance Business Partner
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly driven Finance Business Partner to support strategic business initiatives and international expansion. This role will act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, ensuring financial rigor while enabling fast, sustainable growth.


You will operate at the intersection of finance and strategy — shaping investment decisions, strengthening financial governance, and delivering insights that directly influence business performance.


This position is ideal for finance professionals who combine strong analytical capabilities with a commercial mindset and thrive in dynamic, high-growth environments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Financial Partnership: Partner with business leaders across the full financial lifecycle — from planning to execution — providing actionable insights that support data-driven decision-making.
  • Financial Governance & Process Excellence: Design, implement, and continuously optimize financial processes, policies, and controls to enhance operational efficiency while ensuring compliance.
  • Expansion & Market Launch Support: Lead financial readiness for launches in new countries and cities by establishing scalable frameworks, enabling operational continuity, and proactively managing financial risks.
  • Investment Evaluation & Business Case Development: Assess new business opportunities by evaluating investment requirements, expected returns, and financial viability. Provide clear recommendations to support strategic growth initiatives.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting Ownership: Drive the annual budgeting process and rolling forecasts, partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure disciplined financial management and strong resource allocation.
  • Advanced Business Analysis: Build robust financial analysis models to monitor performance, identify opportunities, highlight risks, and guide leadership on profitability and cost optimization.
  • Cross-functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Reporting, and Internal Controls to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and corporate standards.
  • Finance Digitalization: Contribute to the evolution of financial systems and tools by defining analytical and monitoring requirements that improve transparency and decision support.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Robust experience in Finance Business Partnering or similar strategic finance roles.
  • Solid knowledge of financial regulations within Brazil.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to translate complex financial data into strategic recommendations.
  • Advanced analytical skills with proficiency in financial systems and data analysis tools.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
  • Highly adaptable, proactive, and comfortable operating in fast-paced, evolving environments.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • Experience in high-growth industries such as technology, e-commerce, logistics, on-demand platforms, or internet companies .


Why Join Us

  • Be part of a rapidly scaling global business with significant international growth ambitions.
  • Operate as a strategic partner , influencing key investment and operational decisions.
  • Gain broad exposure across financial disciplines while supporting complex, cross-border initiatives.
  • High-impact role with strong visibility among senior stakeholders.

title: Senior Java Developer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 10 years as a Back-End Developer with Java;
  • Experience with the latest versions of Java;
  • Solid experience with Spring Boot, Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, GraphQL and GitHub;
  • Work experience with Microsoft Cloud Azure;
  • Fluency in English (B2+) - Mandatory ;
  • Willing to move to Portugal with our support.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.


For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

title: Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno
description:
Código da vaga: 58034



Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Conhecimentos sólidos em Kubernetes, AWS, e .NET CORE , além de experiência em Arquitetura de Software, SOLID, Clean Code e práticas avançadas de Code Review .
  • CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios
  • 100% remoto.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Delivery Manager para liderar a execução de projetos de implantação de soluções AWS em clientes dos EUA. A posição exige experiência sólida em gestão de projetos de escopo fechado e híbrido, além de forte habilidade de comunicação em inglês (nível C1), para interação com stakeholders internacionais.


Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar projetos complexos de curta duração (em média 3 meses), incluindo assessments, POCs e MVPs.
  • Conduzir implantações de projetos AWS em clientes dos EUA.
  • Liderar equipes multidisciplinares, garantindo alinhamento, motivação e produtividade.
  • Acompanhar e controlar cronogramas, escopo, riscos e entregas.
  • Realizar acompanhamento e controle financeiro dos projetos, garantindo saúde orçamentária e rentabilidade.
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com stakeholders e clientes, assegurando qualidade e satisfação nas entregas.
  • Aplicar práticas de gestão de projetos (de preferência com certificação PMP).


Requisitos

  • Inglês fluente (nível C1) – imprescindível.
  • Experiência comprovada na gestão de projetos complexos, preferencialmente de tecnologia e cloud.
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação de soluções AWS é um diferencial relevante.
  • Experiência em gestão de equipes e coordenação de recursos.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de projetos híbridas (ágil e waterfall).
  • Certificação PMP (desejável).
  • Forte capacidade de organização, comunicação e resolução de problemas.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em consultorias de tecnologia.
  • Atuação prévia em projetos internacionais

title: UGC Content Creator (Freelance)
description:
About the Company

We are a fast-growing global mobile app company building digital products used by millions of people worldwide. Our focus is on creating scalable, data-driven consumer applications that combine creativity, technology, and performance marketing.


Role Overview

Produce high-quality 30–60 second short-form videos for TikTok and Instagram, promoting consumer-focused mobile applications to global audiences.

Translate creative briefs into compelling, performance-oriented content while also bringing fresh, original ideas to the table.

Develop powerful hooks, relatable scenarios, and innovative use cases that capture attention within the first seconds.

Continuously research trends, viral formats, and competitor strategies to keep content relevant and competitive.

Collaborate closely with the Marketing team to align content with growth goals, campaign strategy, and performance metrics.

Share learnings and creative suggestions that help improve overall content strategy, engagement rates, and conversion performance.


Candidate Profile

Strong interest in TikTok, Instagram Reels, and short-form content ecosystems.

Ability to create engaging, high-retention videos that align with platform trends (portfolio or sample work is highly preferred).

Strong creative instinct with the ability to turn everyday concepts into attention-grabbing content.

Confidence on camera — or strong storytelling ability without appearing on camera.

Understanding of audience behavior, content psychology, and the importance of the first 3 seconds.

Self-driven and organized, capable of managing freelance deliverables independently.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, feedback-driven environment.

English proficiency is a plus, as content targets an international audience.


Compensation

Per-Video Payment Model: You’ll receive compensation for each completed and approved video, with ongoing project opportunities based on performance

title: Senior Java Developer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 10 years as a Back-End Developer with Java;
  • Experience with the latest versions of Java;
  • Solid experience with Spring Boot, Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, GraphQL and GitHub;
  • Work experience with Microsoft Cloud Azure;
  • Fluency in English (B2+) - Mandatory ;
  • Willing to move to Portugal with our support.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.


For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

title: Learning & Development Senior Manager
description:
Job Summary:

The L&D Senior Manager is responsible for applying employee training programs, conducting training needs analysis, and developing engaging learning content. This role ensures smooth training logistics, maintains training records, and supports the continuous improvement of L&D initiatives.


Key Responsibilities:

1 . Training Program Application

  • Schedule, organize, and deliver training programs through lectures, workshops, videos, e-learning, and blended formats.
  • Apply training logistics, including scheduling, venue bookings, facilitator coordination, and employee enrollment.
  • Maintain and update the Learning Management System (LMS) and training records.
  • Handle administrative duties such as tracking attendance, sending reminders, and managing training budgets.


2. New Employee Orientation Facilitation

  • Design, update, and facilitate engaging onboarding programs for new hires.
  • Collaborate with HR and department leaders to ensure a smooth transition for new employees.
  • Continuously improve trainings based on feedback and evolving company needs.


3. Training Needs Analysis & Evaluation

  • Conduct surveys, interviews, and performance assessments to identify skill gaps.
  • Monitor and evaluate training effectiveness through feedback, quizzes, and KPIs (e.g., completion rates, performance improvement).
  • Adjust training programs based on data insights to enhance engagement and knowledge retention.


4. Content & Training Material Development

  • Create and update training manuals, guides, job aids, and digital resources for employee learning.
  • Develop interactive content (e-learning modules, videos, quizzes, presentations).
  • Ensure materials comply with company policies and industry standards.


5. Training Delivery & Facilitation

  • Conduct engaging live and virtual training sessions for employees at all levels.
  • Use diverse training methods (role-playing, simulations, discussions) to maximize learning.
  • Provide post-training support to reinforce key concepts.


6. Stakeholder Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with department heads to align training with business goals.
  • Support ad-hoc Learning initiatives (leadership development, new employees training, etc.).
  • Promote a culture of continuous learning through newsletters, LMS updates, and recognition programs.


Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in HR, Organizational Development, Education, or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years in Learning, training application, or HR, including facilitation and content creation.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • Technical Skills (Preferred/Nice-to-Have): Familiarity with LMS platforms and e-learning tools and knowledge of MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel) and video training software.
  • Soft Skills: Strong organizational and project management abilities, Engaging facilitator with excellent presentation and communication skills. Analytical mindset to assess training effectiveness and adapt programs.


***Work model: In-office 5x a week.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Delivery Manager para liderar a execução de projetos de implantação de soluções AWS em clientes dos EUA. A posição exige experiência sólida em gestão de projetos de escopo fechado e híbrido, além de forte habilidade de comunicação em inglês (nível C1), para interação com stakeholders internacionais.


Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar projetos complexos de curta duração (em média 3 meses), incluindo assessments, POCs e MVPs.
  • Conduzir implantações de projetos AWS em clientes dos EUA.
  • Liderar equipes multidisciplinares, garantindo alinhamento, motivação e produtividade.
  • Acompanhar e controlar cronogramas, escopo, riscos e entregas.
  • Realizar acompanhamento e controle financeiro dos projetos, garantindo saúde orçamentária e rentabilidade.
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com stakeholders e clientes, assegurando qualidade e satisfação nas entregas.
  • Aplicar práticas de gestão de projetos (de preferência com certificação PMP).


Requisitos

  • Inglês fluente (nível C1) – imprescindível.
  • Experiência comprovada na gestão de projetos complexos, preferencialmente de tecnologia e cloud.
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação de soluções AWS é um diferencial relevante.

  • Conhecimento em metodologias de projetos híbridas (ágil e waterfall).

title: UGC Content Creator (Freelance)
description:
About the Company

We are a fast-growing global mobile app company building digital products used by millions of people worldwide. Our focus is on creating scalable, data-driven consumer applications that combine creativity, technology, and performance marketing.


Role Overview

Produce high-quality 30–60 second short-form videos for TikTok and Instagram, promoting consumer-focused mobile applications to global audiences.

Translate creative briefs into compelling, performance-oriented content while also bringing fresh, original ideas to the table.

Develop powerful hooks, relatable scenarios, and innovative use cases that capture attention within the first seconds.

Continuously research trends, viral formats, and competitor strategies to keep content relevant and competitive.

Collaborate closely with the Marketing team to align content with growth goals, campaign strategy, and performance metrics.

Share learnings and creative suggestions that help improve overall content strategy, engagement rates, and conversion performance.


Candidate Profile

Strong interest in TikTok, Instagram Reels, and short-form content ecosystems.

Ability to create engaging, high-retention videos that align with platform trends (portfolio or sample work is highly preferred).

Strong creative instinct with the ability to turn everyday concepts into attention-grabbing content.

Confidence on camera — or strong storytelling ability without appearing on camera.

Understanding of audience behavior, content psychology, and the importance of the first 3 seconds.

Self-driven and organized, capable of managing freelance deliverables independently.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, feedback-driven environment.

English proficiency is a plus, as content targets an international audience.


Compensation

Per-Video Payment Model: You’ll receive compensation for each completed and approved video, with ongoing project opportunities based on performance

title: Senior Java Developer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 10 years as a Back-End Developer with Java;
  • Experience with the latest versions of Java;
  • Solid experience with Spring Boot, Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, GraphQL and GitHub;
  • Work experience with Microsoft Cloud Azure;
  • Fluency in English (B2+) - Mandatory ;
  • Willing to move to Portugal with our support.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

title: Python Developer
description:
Python GCP Developer


Language: Portuguese & English

Position: Remote

Experience: Mid to Senior


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement serverless cloud solutions using GCP Cloud Functions;
  • Design data models and manage largescale data storage with GCP Bigtable;
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to cloud functions and associated services;
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to automate deployment and monitoring of cloud functions;
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance cloud infrastructure and application performance;
  • Mentor and support team members in adopting best practices for Python and GCP development;
  • Document technical designs processes and best practices for knowledge sharing;
  • Engage with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions;
  • Ensure adherence to security best practices in cloud deployments;
  • Stay updated with the latest GCP advancements and industry trends.


Mandatory Knowledge

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent work experience;
  • 5 to 7 years of experience in development;
  • Proficiency in Python, GCP Bigtable and GCP Cloud Functions;
  • Hands on experience with designing data models, developing and automation and deployment of cloud functions.



Does this sounds like something you'd like to do?

Apply and attach your resume in English and we'll take it from here. Excited to meet you!

title: UGC Content Creator (Freelance)
description:
About the Company

We are a fast-growing global mobile app company building digital products used by millions of people worldwide. Our focus is on creating scalable, data-driven consumer applications that combine creativity, technology, and performance marketing.


Role Overview

Produce high-quality 30–60 second short-form videos for TikTok and Instagram, promoting consumer-focused mobile applications to global audiences.

Translate creative briefs into compelling, performance-oriented content while also bringing fresh, original ideas to the table.

Develop powerful hooks, relatable scenarios, and innovative use cases that capture attention within the first seconds.

Continuously research trends, viral formats, and competitor strategies to keep content relevant and competitive.

Collaborate closely with the Marketing team to align content with growth goals, campaign strategy, and performance metrics.

Share learnings and creative suggestions that help improve overall content strategy, engagement rates, and conversion performance.


Candidate Profile

Strong interest in TikTok, Instagram Reels, and short-form content ecosystems.

Ability to create engaging, high-retention videos that align with platform trends (portfolio or sample work is highly preferred).

Strong creative instinct with the ability to turn everyday concepts into attention-grabbing content.

Confidence on camera — or strong storytelling ability without appearing on camera.

Understanding of audience behavior, content psychology, and the importance of the first 3 seconds.

Self-driven and organized, capable of managing freelance deliverables independently.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, feedback-driven environment.

English proficiency is a plus, as content targets an international audience.


Compensation

Per-Video Payment Model: You’ll receive compensation for each completed and approved video, with ongoing project opportunities based on performance

title: Senior Java Developer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 10 years as a Back-End Developer with Java;
  • Experience with the latest versions of Java;
  • Solid experience with Spring Boot, Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, GraphQL and GitHub;
  • Work experience with Microsoft Cloud Azure;
  • Fluency in English (B2+) - Mandatory ;
  • Willing to move to Portugal with our support.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.


For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno
description:
Código da vaga: 58034



Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Conhecimentos sólidos em Kubernetes, AWS, e .NET CORE , além de experiência em Arquitetura de Software, SOLID, Clean Code e práticas avançadas de Code Review .
  • CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios
  • 100% remoto.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Able Seaman (Marinheiro de Convés)
description:
Airswift busca para cliente do setor O&G: AB – Able Seaman (Marinheiro de Convés) para projeto de 9 meses.


Job Overview

O AB participa diretamente das operações de convés, manobras, manutenção e vigilância. Esse profissional é fundamental para a segurança e eficiência das manobras da embarcação.

Duração do projeto: 9 meses, com possibilidade de extensão.

Key Responsibilities

  • Atuar em operações de amarração, ancoragem e manobras.
  • Realizar manutenção geral: pintura, limpeza, reparos.
  • Atuar como vigia e leme durante a navegação.
  • Participar de drills e rotinas de emergência.

Qualifications

  • Certificação STCW + credencial AB válida.
  • Experiência prévia em operações de convés.

title: Analytics, AI and Data Scientist
description:
Remoov is a fast-growing startup that is enabling the circular economy. We are unlocking the value of the $100B used goods industry by removing the friction of upcycling your items, reducing waste by increasing reuse!. We operate in the intersection of tech-enabled operations and sales automation.


Our Stack:

Postgres, Python, Metabase, PostHog, scikit-learn, pandas, numpy, matplotlib, seaborn


Why work with us:

  • Ability to work remotely with a distributed team
  • A small team that loves to learn and experiment
  • Exposure to modern technologies
  • Opportunity to make a real impact in the company’s direction and growth


What we are looking for:

  • Strong foundation of Python
  • Practical knowledge of Git
  • Strong problem solving ability and analytical skills
  • Entrepreneurial spirit
  • Conversational in English
  • We are looking for candidates in Brazil or able to speak Portuguese


Responsibilities:

  • Analyze data and build models to improve the business operations
  • Build dashboards and reports to help the business make data-driven decisions
  • Run A/B testing and data experiments to validate hypothesis
  • Develop data pipeline, statistical modeling, and collaborate on model deployment
  • Design, develop and maintain secure, stable, scalable, and extensible solutions


Compensation Brazilian real 12,000 - 15,000 BRL per month + 0.02% equity in the company.


Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Project Manager with warehouse experience - Remote
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least ten years of professional experience in successfully executing and managing complex IT projects;
  • Experience working with Logistic integration Projects - mandatory ;
  • Experience with 3PL Integrations - mandatory ;
  • Strong experience in project management methodologies (classic and agile);
  • Organized, result-oriented work style characterized by a high degree of initiative;
  • PMP certification - plus;
  • Written and oral fluency in English (+B2) - mandatory .


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: remote.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
SRE (Site Reliability Engineer) + DevOp:

Localização: Remoto

Tipo de Contrato: CLT


Descrição da Vaga:

Buscamos um profissional SRE com habilidades em DevOps para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, disponibilidade e desempenho das nossas aplicações e infraestrutura. Este profissional atuará em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para promover uma cultura de automação e melhoria contínua.


Responsabilidades:

- Garantir a disponibilidade e a performance das aplicações e serviços, monitorando métricas e implementando soluções proativas.

- Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento para criar e implementar práticas de DevOps, como CI/CD (Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua).

- Automatizar processos de infraestrutura utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible ou similares.

- Implementar e gerenciar ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (como Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, etc.).

- Responder a incidentes e realizar análises de causa raiz para melhorar a confiabilidade do sistema.

- Participar da definição e implementação de políticas de segurança e conformidade.

- Ajudar na gestão de infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.).

- Documentar processos, procedimentos e configurações de infraestrutura.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em práticas de SRE e DevOps.

- Conhecimento em linguagens de programação e scripts (Python, Go, Bash, etc.).

- Experiência com ferramentas de automação de infraestrutura (Terraform, Puppet, Chef, Ansible, etc.).

- Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc.).

- Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.).

- Conhecimento em contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Habilidade em solucionar problemas e trabalhar de forma independente.

- Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.


Diferenciais:

- Experiência em gestão de incidentes e resposta a emergências.

- Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

- Certificações relevantes (AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer, etc.).

- Familiaridade com práticas de segurança em DevOps (DevSecOps).

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of back-end software development experience, a strong background in Node.js, and experience using AI code generation tools to join the engineering team of our U.S. client. Working closely with product stakeholders, you will play an integral role in building an industry-leading product.


The client is focused on greater AI-first development, so a significant part of your role will involve designing and implementing AI-driven features using AI-first development techniques. This includes leveraging prompt engineering to optimize the client's AI models and utilizing cutting-edge tools, such as Cursor and Copilot, to enable smarter development.


As a Sr. Software Engineer, your job is to work between the front-end and product teams to create, publish, and develop clean software. Youll create software that facilitates veterinarian-patient communication and reduces the burden on clinic staff! You must see the big picture of where the client is going and fill in the gaps. Do you actively integrate AI tools and techniques into your daily engineering workflow? Do you support thoughtful discussions and challenge existing ideas? Share what you know, learn what you don't.


Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded and growth-stage, comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new applications and features
  • Build and enhance advanced applications using Node.js
  • Design and implement AI-first features using LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude)
  • Integrate and leverage AI development tools like Cursor and Copilot
  • Provide estimates for features, bug fixes, upgrades, and new projects
  • Participate in clearly and concisely documenting applications and custom-built frameworks
  • Write automated unit and feature tests enabling continuous delivery of your great work
  • Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies (especially AI-related) to maximize development efficiency
  • Support other teammates through good communication and feedback during code reviews
  • See the big picture and support the client's mission of facilitating better pet care


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of engineering experience working on consumer-facing (B2C or B2B), high-volume, commercial software products and services
  • 3+ years of experience with Node.js, Express, and TypeScript (bonus)
  • Proven expertise in prompt engineering for various AI models
  • Regular use of AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, or others to streamline development is preferred
  • A curiosity to explore how you can improve your workflow using AI
  • Experience with object-oriented programming patterns
  • Experience with scaling and performance improvement
  • Knowledge of both relational and non-relational database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB)
  • High execution mindset while balancing the risk vs costs vs timeline
  • Proven history of delivering production-ready applications promptly
  • Experience creating and consuming API's (preferably with GraphQL)
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services (server setup a bonus)
  • Team player eager to learn from and mentor others
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Strong experience with AI-first development methodologies


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

title: Freelancer Analista de Dados de Mídia
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar em uma função essencial para garantir a qualidade, consistência e integridade dos dados que sustentam as decisões de mídia da marca. É uma vaga para quem gosta de mergulhar em bases, transformar dados brutos em informação útil e conectar análises ao dia a dia operacional do planejamento e da compra de mídia.

Principais Atribuições

  • Monitorar, tratar e consolidar dados das diferentes bases internas que abastecem a operação de mídia.
  • Executar rotinas de extração e manipulação de dados utilizando SQL e ferramentas analíticas.
  • Estruturar informações em Excel de maneira clara, organizada e confiável para uso do time.
  • Realizar a migração manual e o input de dados na Media Tool da Heineken, garantindo precisão e aderência às regras do cliente.
  • Ler e interpretar solicitações do cliente para traduzir necessidades em entregas de dados estruturadas.
  • Conectar informações financeiras, operacionais e de planejamento para garantir coerência entre PI, custos, métricas e investimentos.
  • Apoiar o time na análise de tendências, inconsistências e oportunidades de melhoria nos fluxos de dados.

Requisitos

  • Conhecimento sólido de mídia: PI, custos bruto e líquido, métricas fundamentais, composições de investimento e lógica de planejamento.
  • Experiência com SQL (essencial) e familiaridade com Python para manipulação e tratamento de dados.
  • Sólida habilidade com Excel para consolidações, validações e cruzamentos.
  • Rigor na checagem de informações, atenção a detalhes e comprometimento com a qualidade dos dados.
  • Boa capacidade analítica, organização e clareza para comunicar achados.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com ferramentas proprietárias ou plataformas internas de anunciantes.
  • Experiência anterior em operações de mídia ou times de Data & Analytics.
  • Familiaridade com processos de QA, automação ou documentação técnica.

title: Analytics, AI and Data Scientist
description:
Remoov is a fast-growing startup that is enabling the circular economy. We are unlocking the value of the $100B used goods industry by removing the friction of upcycling your items, reducing waste by increasing reuse!. We operate in the intersection of tech-enabled operations and sales automation.


Our Stack:

Postgres, Python, Metabase, PostHog, scikit-learn, pandas, numpy, matplotlib, seaborn


Why work with us:

  • Ability to work remotely with a distributed team
  • A small team that loves to learn and experiment
  • Exposure to modern technologies
  • Opportunity to make a real impact in the company’s direction and growth


What we are looking for:

  • Strong foundation of Python
  • Practical knowledge of Git
  • Strong problem solving ability and analytical skills
  • Entrepreneurial spirit
  • Conversational in English
  • We are looking for candidates in Brazil or able to speak Portuguese


Responsibilities:

  • Analyze data and build models to improve the business operations
  • Build dashboards and reports to help the business make data-driven decisions
  • Run A/B testing and data experiments to validate hypothesis
  • Develop data pipeline, statistical modeling, and collaborate on model deployment
  • Design, develop and maintain secure, stable, scalable, and extensible solutions


Compensation Brazilian real 12,000 - 15,000 BRL per month + 0.02% equity in the company.


Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
SRE (Site Reliability Engineer) + DevOp:

Localização: Remoto

Tipo de Contrato: CLT


Descrição da Vaga:

Buscamos um profissional SRE com habilidades em DevOps para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, disponibilidade e desempenho das nossas aplicações e infraestrutura. Este profissional atuará em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para promover uma cultura de automação e melhoria contínua.


Responsabilidades:

- Garantir a disponibilidade e a performance das aplicações e serviços, monitorando métricas e implementando soluções proativas.

- Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento para criar e implementar práticas de DevOps, como CI/CD (Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua).

- Automatizar processos de infraestrutura utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible ou similares.

- Implementar e gerenciar ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (como Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, etc.).

- Responder a incidentes e realizar análises de causa raiz para melhorar a confiabilidade do sistema.

- Participar da definição e implementação de políticas de segurança e conformidade.

- Ajudar na gestão de infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.).

- Documentar processos, procedimentos e configurações de infraestrutura.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em práticas de SRE e DevOps.

- Conhecimento em linguagens de programação e scripts (Python, Go, Bash, etc.).

- Experiência com ferramentas de automação de infraestrutura (Terraform, Puppet, Chef, Ansible, etc.).

- Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc.).

- Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.).

- Conhecimento em contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Habilidade em solucionar problemas e trabalhar de forma independente.

- Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.


Diferenciais:

- Experiência em gestão de incidentes e resposta a emergências.

- Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

- Certificações relevantes (AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer, etc.).

- Familiaridade com práticas de segurança em DevOps (DevSecOps).

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of back-end software development experience, a strong background in Node.js, and experience using AI code generation tools to join the engineering team of our U.S. client. Working closely with product stakeholders, you will play an integral role in building an industry-leading product.


The client is focused on greater AI-first development, so a significant part of your role will involve designing and implementing AI-driven features using AI-first development techniques. This includes leveraging prompt engineering to optimize the client's AI models and utilizing cutting-edge tools, such as Cursor and Copilot, to enable smarter development.


As a Sr. Software Engineer, your job is to work between the front-end and product teams to create, publish, and develop clean software. Youll create software that facilitates veterinarian-patient communication and reduces the burden on clinic staff! You must see the big picture of where the client is going and fill in the gaps. Do you actively integrate AI tools and techniques into your daily engineering workflow? Do you support thoughtful discussions and challenge existing ideas? Share what you know, learn what you don't.


Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded and growth-stage, comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new applications and features
  • Build and enhance advanced applications using Node.js
  • Design and implement AI-first features using LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude)
  • Integrate and leverage AI development tools like Cursor and Copilot
  • Provide estimates for features, bug fixes, upgrades, and new projects
  • Participate in clearly and concisely documenting applications and custom-built frameworks
  • Write automated unit and feature tests enabling continuous delivery of your great work
  • Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies (especially AI-related) to maximize development efficiency
  • Support other teammates through good communication and feedback during code reviews
  • See the big picture and support the client's mission of facilitating better pet care


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of engineering experience working on consumer-facing (B2C or B2B), high-volume, commercial software products and services
  • 3+ years of experience with Node.js, Express, and TypeScript (bonus)
  • Proven expertise in prompt engineering for various AI models
  • Regular use of AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, or others to streamline development is preferred
  • A curiosity to explore how you can improve your workflow using AI
  • Experience with object-oriented programming patterns
  • Experience with scaling and performance improvement
  • Knowledge of both relational and non-relational database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB)
  • High execution mindset while balancing the risk vs costs vs timeline
  • Proven history of delivering production-ready applications promptly
  • Experience creating and consuming API's (preferably with GraphQL)
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services (server setup a bonus)
  • Team player eager to learn from and mentor others
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Strong experience with AI-first development methodologies


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Freelancer Analista de Dados de Mídia
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar em uma função essencial para garantir a qualidade, consistência e integridade dos dados que sustentam as decisões de mídia da marca. É uma vaga para quem gosta de mergulhar em bases, transformar dados brutos em informação útil e conectar análises ao dia a dia operacional do planejamento e da compra de mídia.

Principais Atribuições

  • Monitorar, tratar e consolidar dados das diferentes bases internas que abastecem a operação de mídia.
  • Executar rotinas de extração e manipulação de dados utilizando SQL e ferramentas analíticas.
  • Estruturar informações em Excel de maneira clara, organizada e confiável para uso do time.
  • Realizar a migração manual e o input de dados na Media Tool da Heineken, garantindo precisão e aderência às regras do cliente.
  • Ler e interpretar solicitações do cliente para traduzir necessidades em entregas de dados estruturadas.
  • Conectar informações financeiras, operacionais e de planejamento para garantir coerência entre PI, custos, métricas e investimentos.
  • Apoiar o time na análise de tendências, inconsistências e oportunidades de melhoria nos fluxos de dados.

Requisitos

  • Conhecimento sólido de mídia: PI, custos bruto e líquido, métricas fundamentais, composições de investimento e lógica de planejamento.
  • Experiência com SQL (essencial) e familiaridade com Python para manipulação e tratamento de dados.
  • Sólida habilidade com Excel para consolidações, validações e cruzamentos.
  • Rigor na checagem de informações, atenção a detalhes e comprometimento com a qualidade dos dados.
  • Boa capacidade analítica, organização e clareza para comunicar achados.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com ferramentas proprietárias ou plataformas internas de anunciantes.
  • Experiência anterior em operações de mídia ou times de Data & Analytics.
  • Familiaridade com processos de QA, automação ou documentação técnica.

title: Gerente de projetos Oracle
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Projetos Oracle Sênior para atuar em iniciativas de implantação e melhorias de sistemas, com forte interface entre times locais e globais. O profissional será responsável por conduzir a governança do projeto, liderar rituais, realizar alinhamentos estratégicos e garantir a aderência às diretrizes corporativas.


Responsabilidades

Liderar projetos Oracle relacionados a implantação, melhorias e evolução da plataforma.

Atuar como ponto focal entre o time local e global, garantindo alinhamento contínuo.

Conduzir toda a governança de projetos , incluindo:

  • rituais de acompanhamento,
  • status reports executivos,
  • steering committees.

Gerenciar riscos, issues, mudanças e dependências do projeto.

Estruturar e controlar cronograma, escopo, orçamento e indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) .

Garantir o cumprimento de prazos e a aderência às diretrizes globais e padrões corporativos.

Atuar de forma consultiva, apoiando o cliente na tomada de decisões estratégicas.


Requisitos

Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Projetos atuando em iniciativas Oracle.

Vivência sólida em governança de PMO : gestão de cronograma, escopo, custos, riscos e stakeholders.

Experiência em ambientes corporativos estruturados e com interação multicultural.

Inglês avançado , com boa comunicação oral e escrita.

Senioridade compatível com atuação estratégica e executiva.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Atuação prévia em projetos com alinhamento ou reporte para times globais.
  • Vivência em ambientes com processos corporativos complexos.


Contexto dos Projetos

  • Projetos de implantação e melhorias em soluções Oracle.
  • Escopo majoritariamente local , porém com necessidade de alinhamento constante com times globais.
  • Participação em um ambiente multicultural e corporativo com padrões globais de governança.

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions
